events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album that still resonates with its message of peace and unity. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: British musician and former Police frontman Sting celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, his music has spanned decades. What's your go-to Sting track?

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Original MP3 Player
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since the original iPod dropped, changing music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The Beatles' Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental classic. What's your favourite track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the tragic passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: 35 years. Still irreplaceable. Remembering the incredible talent and showmanship of Freddie Mercury today. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Beatles Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed their sound in new directions. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating the Starman
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the incredible artistry and enduring legacy of David Bowie. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy 92nd birthday to the King, Elvis Presley! His music still gets us moving. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has given us so many classics. Which one is your favourite?
